newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rodamco raises final 1996/97 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Rodamco raises final 1996/97 net profit.

text.p: Property investment fund Rodamco said on Thursday its final net profit for the year to February 28, 1997 totalled 460 million guilders.
In March, the company said it expected a 1996/97 net profit of 447 million guilders, barely changed from the 446 million posted in the previous financial year.
The final 1996/97 net per share was 2.89 guilders, up from 2.81 guilders expected in March. In the previous year it posted a net per share of 2.80 guilders.
Rodamco said it intended to pay a dividend of 2.88 guilders. In March it expected to make an unchanged payment of 2.80 guilders per share.
The company said the 1996/97 dividend could be taken up in cash or in new shares. Details of the stock dividend alternative will be published on June 19.
